name: Yasith Samaradivakara
bio: Yasith is extremely passionate about building intelligent assistive wearables and digital interfaces that unlock and augment human capabilities. He is interested in solving questions at the intersection of Assistive Interfaces, Human-Computer Interaction, and Artificial Intelligence. Apart from computers, Yasith loves playing cricket.
